scripts.dev:api: uv run --project backend uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir backend --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload
scripts.lint: eslint apps/web/src e2e playwright.config.ts && uv run --project backend ruff check backend
scripts.format: prettier --write . && uv run --project backend ruff format backend
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && uv run --project backend ruff format --check backend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace apps/web && uv run --project backend pytest backend/tests
